requirements_summary: Workloads: low-latency stateful chat (multi-turn) + reranking for search; peak profiles aligned to market open/close spikes
Throughput targets: sustained 1,200 inference requests/min during peaks (~20 rps sustained) for the chat service; bursts up to 200 rps for embedding/rerank pipelines
Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end first-token <= 300ms for chat; p99 token-streaming tail <= 1.2s for critical flows
Reserved GPU planning: estimate 6x A100-equivalent GPUs baseline, want headroom for 2x burst nodes; need clear reserved vs burst billing
Autoscaling policy preferences: fast scale-up (add nodes within 60s for queue growth), conservative scale-down (grace >= 10m), warm pools to avoid cold KV cache misses
Warm pools & pre-warm strategy: maintain small set of hot replicas per region (warm_pool_min=2 per zone) and ondemand pre-warm window before predictable spikes
Queueing behavior: prefer bounded priority queueing with backpressure and SLA-aware drop/redirect policies rather than infinite queueing
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to a slightly smaller model variant for heavy load; fallback must preserve consistency for user-facing sessions
Observability: token-level latency, per-model throughput, queueing lengths, warm pool utilization, and rollback hooks required for POC
Compliance: customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention 7 years, region-locked storage for logs and model artifacts
sla_targets: Uptime: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated capacity per region
Latency: p95 first-byte <= 300ms, p99 streaming tail <= 1.2s (measured at load balancer ingress)
Throughput: guaranteed baseline of 1,200 req/min with autoscale to 2,400 req/min within 60s of sustained queue growth
Scale behavior: scale-up to required nodes within 60s; scale-down grace period not less than 10 minutes; warm-pool pre-warm must be configurable
poc_success_criteria: No cold-start 95th percentile spikes during two simulated market-open events (48h window)
Autoscale events respond within agreed thresholds and do not drop >0.1% of high-priority requests
Warm pool hit-rate >= 85% for chat KV cache during peak simulations
Observability: all hooks connected to Calyx Splunk instance and Redwood Console metrics dashboard
